hook: Every spider starts the fight hidden under a Lid and springs out with a free first strike when something knocks.
loop: Choose which units stand open and which wait under Lids.
Knocks open Lids for Springs; Lids shut through a win turn Patient.
Spring chains win fights; Patient units grow permanently each turn.

growth.line: Wins make units Patient, which grow next turn, fastest with Mabyn; Springs mostly give in-fight stats.

feel.early: Thin; Patience rarely pays before Tier 3.
feel.mid: Placing Lids against the scouted board: fuel or savings.
feel.late: Spring chains replay, or a Patient board snowballs.

stars.why: Stabs the enemy across before each attack, then hides again.
Hidden aura: powers every Spring from where no enemy reaches.
Tier 6 payoff: a streak of shut doors becomes a big board.

card_short.u01: Springs when the enemy across attacks.
card_short.u02: Opens when a friend dies; grows each turn while Patient.
card_short.u03: Springs when a neighbour dies, then opens a nearby Lid.
card_short.u04: When played: permanent buff, doubled on a Patient unit.
card_short.u05: Gold each turn if units stayed Patient or Lids opened.
card_short.u06: When played: gives any unit a Lid and +2/+2.
card_short.u07: Grows Attack under its Lid; opens after three friendly deaths.
card_short.u08: No Knock. Each turn, buffs every other Patient unit permanently.
card_short.u09: Springs when a nearby Lid opens; buffs the next Spring.
card_short.u10: Springs when the enemy across attacks; summons two Nieces.
card_short.u11: Each turn, permanent stats to Lidded units per Lid opened.
card_short.u12: Once a fight, closes a Lid again after it Springs.
card_short.u13: Hides Underneath a friend, Springs with half its stats.
card_short.u14: Opens last; every other Spring gets +4/+4 first.
card_short.u15: Stabs the enemy across before it attacks, then closes again.
card_short.u17: Opens last; each turn, Patient units grow per Patient unit.
card_short.u18: After four Lids open, every Sprung unit Springs again.
card_short.u19: Fills empty slots with Lidded Spiderlings each fight.
card_short.x01: Summoned open 3/3 bait that dies beside a Lid.
card_short.x02: Fight-only 4/4 under a Lid; Springs when a neighbour dies.

builds.name: Closed Meeting
builds.line: Strong open units win; Lids stay shut, turn Patient, grow.

builds.name: Sprung Trap
builds.line: Cheap bait in front; one death sets off a Spring chain.

builds.name: Initiates
builds.line: Usher and Sexton hide other tribes' best units under Lids.

liked: All three: choosing which Lids are fuel and which are savings drives every turn.
No other tribe hides its fighting board; doors redirect attacks and blind scouts.
worries: Mabyn plus Diadem could snowball on win streaks; unclear if she counts herself.
Slit-Mender combo kills before enemies swing; Worshipful Master replays and Jill's slot-filling also flagged.
changed: Worshipful Master wakes after four Lids open, not all of them.
Ballot Clerk and Orbweaver now pay off both springing and waiting.
Rules tightened: Spring hits the knocker first; Past Master doubles only Spring text.
verdict: If hidden boards and planned chains appeal, your spiders wait under Lids and spring at the first knock.
